segments.name: Dealerships
segments.description: Runs franchised dealerships selling vehicles, parts, service and finance products.
segments.evidence: Our store operations are conducted by our subsidiaries and the Company operates in two reportable segments, Dealerships and TCA.

segments.name: TCA
segments.description: Sells vehicle protection and finance products through its own and independent dealerships.
segments.evidence: Our TCA segment revenues, reflected in F&I revenue, net, are derived from the sale of various vehicle protection products including vehicle service contracts, GAP, prepaid maintenance contracts, and appearance protection contracts.

revenueModel.text: Vehicle buyers pay dealerships for cars, parts, service and finance products, and TCA for protection contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: F&I products are offered by dealerships to customers in connection with the purchase of vehicles through either TCA or independent third parties.
